column1: # 職場與人事
employee|n.|員工|Every [employee receives training].|每位員工都會接受訓練。
employer|n.|雇主|The [employer provides insurance].|雇主提供保險。
staff|n.|全體員工|Our [staff work remotely].|我們的員工遠端工作。
personnel|n.|人事；員工|Contact the [personnel department].|請聯絡人事部門。
workforce|n.|勞動人力|The [workforce is expanding].|員工人數正在增加。
occupation|n.|職業|Please [state your occupation].|請填寫您的職業。
career|n.|職涯|She wants a [career in finance].|她想從事金融業。
position|n.|職位|We have a [management position] available.|我們有管理職缺。
vacant|adj.|空缺的|The [vacant position] requires experience.|這個空缺職位需要工作經驗。
resume|n.|履歷|Please [send your resume].|請寄送您的履歷。
interview|n.|面試|Her [job interview] is tomorrow.|她的求職面試在明天。
hire|v.|雇用|We will [hire an assistant].|我們將雇用一位助理。
employment|n.|就業；雇用|The agency offers [employment services].|這家機構提供就業服務。
appraisal|n.|評核|Your [performance appraisal] is next week.|你的績效評核在下週。
performance|n.|表現|The award recognizes [outstanding performance].|這個獎項表揚傑出表現。
probation|n.|試用期|New hires complete [three months of probation].|新進員工需完成三個月的試用期。
retirement|n.|退休|He is [planning for retirement].|他正在規劃退休生活。
pension|n.|退休金|The company offers a [pension plan].|公司提供退休金計畫。
benefit|n.|福利|Paid leave is an [employee benefit].|有薪假是員工福利。
bonus|n.|獎金|Employees received an [annual bonus].|員工領到了年度獎金。
wage|n.|工資|The [hourly wage] has increased.|時薪已調高。
overtime|n.|加班|We receive [overtime pay].|我們有加班費。
shift|n.|輪班班次|She works the [night shift].|她上夜班。
leave|n.|假期|He is on [sick leave].|他正在請病假。
absence|n.|缺席|Please explain your [absence from work].|請說明你未到班的原因。
attendance|n.|出席|We keep [attendance records].|我們保留出席紀錄。
training|n.|訓練|The course provides [practical training].|這門課提供實務訓練。
trainee|n.|受訓人員|Each [trainee has a mentor].|每位受訓人員都有一位導師。
mentor|n.|導師|My [mentor offered advice].|我的導師提供了建議。
intern|n.|實習生|The [intern joined our team].|這位實習生加入了我們的團隊。
internship|n.|實習|She completed a [summer internship].|她完成了暑期實習。
reference|n.|推薦人；推薦資料|Please provide a [professional reference].|請提供一位工作上的推薦人。
background|n.|背景|He has a [background in accounting].|他有會計方面的背景。
experience|n.|經驗|This role requires [previous experience].|這個職位需要先前的工作經驗。
skill|n.|技能|Writing is a [valuable skill].|寫作是一項寶貴的技能。
competent|adj.|能勝任的|She is a [competent manager].|她是一位能勝任工作的經理。
qualified|adj.|合格的|We need a [qualified technician].|我們需要一位合格的技術人員。
responsibility|n.|責任|Safety is [everyone's responsibility].|安全是每個人的責任。
duty|n.|職責|Answering calls is your [main duty].|接聽電話是你的主要職責。
teamwork|n.|團隊合作|This project requires [effective teamwork].|這個專案需要有效的團隊合作。
leadership|n.|領導能力|The course develops [leadership skills].|這門課培養領導技能。
motivate|v.|激勵|Clear goals [motivate employees].|明確的目標能激勵員工。
dismiss|v.|解雇|The firm may [dismiss the employee].|公司可能解雇這位員工。
transfer|v.|調動|They will [transfer her to sales].|他們將把她調到業務部門。
appoint|v.|任命|We will [appoint a new director].|我們將任命一位新主管。
recruitment|n.|招募|The [recruitment process] takes weeks.|招募流程需要數週。
